title: How do I tape a cardboard box for shipping?
summary: Seal a four-flap shipping box with three strips of packing tape on the bottom and three on the top, covering the center seam and both edge seams in an H pattern.

items.title: How do I tape a cardboard box for shipping?
items.summary: Seal a four-flap shipping box with three strips of packing tape on the bottom and three on the top, covering the center seam and both edge seams in an H pattern.
items.buyerNote: Start with the empty box upside down. Close the flaps and run the first strip along the line where the two outer flaps meet. Put one strip across each end so the tape folds over the edge onto the side wall. Turn the box upright, pack it, then repeat on top. For FedEx parcels in the UK, use shipping tape at least 5 cm wide.
